description: Market regime classifier. Consumes FEATURES_CALCULATED, runs priority cascade (Volatility > MeanReversion > SMATrend), applies hysteresis and slope gate, emits EVT:REGIME_DETECTED with stable per-symbol structural regime and confidence on every basis bar close.

ssot_notes.regime_labels: TREND_UP, TREND_DOWN, MEAN_REVERSION, HIGH_VOLATILITY, LOW_VOLATILITY, UNCERTAIN — raw strings (no shared Enum class)
ssot_notes.detection_cascade: Priority: Volatility (ATR) > MeanReversion (SMA spread) > SMATrend (SMA crossover) > UNCERTAIN
ssot_notes.hysteresis: Raw regime stabilised through hysteresis_bars consecutive confirmations before transitioning stable regime
ssot_notes.slope_gate: HIGH_VOLATILITY suppressed when vol_ratio slope decreasing (dying storm pattern)
ssot_notes.regime_layer: Always STRUCTURAL, PER_SYMBOL, BAR-clocked. Uses RuntimeRegimeLayer from contracts
ssot_notes.heartbeat: EVT:REGIME_DETECTED emitted on every basis bar close with 'changed' flag for DM liveness check
ssot_notes.config: AuroraConfig from regime.yaml. models.sma_trend, models.volatility, models.mean_reversion config blocks
